review.summary: The change adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting. Only a 17-20 digit snowflake is accepted (strict anchored regex with /D after trim, int or string only), the alert gets a '<@id>' line at the end, and room is reserved for it inside the 1800-character limit. Requirements, security, docs and tests are all covered thoroughly with minimal code; the only remarks are test-organization nits.
